meta.metric: Brier skill vs past event frequency (climatology): 1 - Brier / Brier of climatology on the same rows; 95% moving-block bootstrap interval
meta.promotion_rule: A challenger is promoted for an (asset, cohort, horizon) only if, on the holdout, (1) its mean Brier is lower than both climatology and the strongest development-period baseline for that cell, (2) the block-bootstrap 95% CI of its Brier difference vs climatology lies entirely below 0 and the verdict is seed-stable, (3) its reliability (mean |observed - forecast| over bins, weighted by count) is no worse than climatology's by more than 0.02, and (4) its coverage is at least 90% of climatology's. Otherwise the simpler baseline is retained and the report says no demonstrated improvement.
meta.promotion_clarifications: Made 2026-10-14 BEFORE the holdout was opened, after an independent pre-flight review that saw no holdout result: coverage (4) is measured on the cell's testable holdout targets; Chronos's price representation is scored on all rows and must also pass on its in-band subset; the strongest development baseline itself is judged against climatology only in (1); cells with no testable holdout targets are reported as untestable; the retained model is the strongest development baseline if it passes against climatology, else climatology.
